value: RPG where you play as two differently sized parties intermittently (Girl / Miniguy).

Psychic Ansel wakes up in a daze, finding himself shrunken after witnessing a magic array in the sky. He discovers that a “Great Shrink” occured while he had secluded himself, leaving many inhabitants of the kingdom of Suraoem stuck at a tiny size. Meanwhile, noble Genevieve and her paladin friend Gabrielle discover a deposit of a legendary power crystal, which may be the missing link to a secret experiment the kingdom has been working on...
